summary: Eastman Chemical filed an 8-K on October 20, 2026, reporting that its board adopted amended and restated bylaws effective October 16, 2026. Changes align bylaws with Delaware law and market practice, revise stockholder special-meeting mechanics and disclosure, update advance-notice windows (120 to 90 days before the annual-meeting anniversary) and set a separate proxy-access window (150 to 120 days), require director nominees to make themselves available for board interviews, adopt plurality voting in contested elections, and clarify the exclusive-forum provision's Exchange Act carve-out. No transaction terms, advisors, or special-situation event; a governance housekeeping filing.
